scope.purpose: Map every source page header to its IVTFF bifolio key without copying source text.
scope.provider_metadata_scope: Complete for the page headers and locus records in both source files.

Q.name: quire number
Q.specification: IVTFF Table 6, $Q: quire number 1 through 20, encoded A through T; P (16) and R (18) are unused.
Q.spec_location: Section 6.3, Table 6, PDF pages 19-20 (one-based), Q and B rows.

B.name: bifolio number within quire
B.specification: IVTFF Table 6, $B: bifolio number within quire, counted outside to inside.
B.spec_location: Section 6.3, Table 6, PDF pages 19-20 (one-based), Q and B rows.

definitions.representative: Minimum numeric folio present in the group. fRos has no single numeric folio and uses its related 85/86 group.

evidence.claim: The specification defines Q and B as quire and bifolio metadata.
evidence.location: Section 6.3, Table 6, PDF pages 19-20 (one-based), Q and B rows.

evidence.claim: Yale records the folding counts and calls f85r-f86v one sextuple-folio folding leaf.
evidence.location: Physical description and collation, lines 34-45 and 70-74

evidence.claim: The specialist description identifies f85 and f86 as one multiple-foldout.
The specialist quire pages and schemata support the scoped foldout and bifolio relations.

cross_corpus_agreement.note: ZL3b adds fRos and f116v page headers. Shared page headers agree on all checked variables.

limitations: This is complete with respect to the provider Q/B metadata in these two source files.
It is not an independent conservation examination. It accepts the source metadata and specialist schemata.
It does not assign missing folios that have no page header in either source file.
A Yale canvas remains an image capture. This manifest does not infer a text reading.
Use whole-quire grouping only as a conservative fallback when Q/B metadata is unavailable.
